{{Quote|The last Gormak must not die&hellip;|Decree of the Voss, enacted after a prophecy by the Voss Mystics|<ref name="Gormak" />}}
The '''Gormak''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], a world in the [[Voss system/Legends|Voss system]] of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They were the more populous of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] two native sentient species&mdash;and they were extremely hostile toward the other, a species known as the [[Voss (species)|Voss]], as well as the off-worlders, whom they viewed as allies of the Voss. The Gormak possessed an innate comprehension of technology, although they did not develop spaceflight capability prior to contact with off-worlders. When the planet Voss was discovered by non-natives shortly around [[3645 BBY]], the Gormak were exposed to the technology of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], gaining the capabilities to construct more advanced weapons and even attempt to build their own starship. During that time, the Voss learned that they were actually descended from Gormak and began an attempt to reconcile between two species. By the time the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] [[Invasion of Voss|invaded Voss]] in [[3630 BBY]], the Voss and Gormak ended their hostilities, uniting to defend their homeworld against the invaders.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Female_Gormak.png|thumb|left|190px|A female Gormak]]
The Gormak were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with green skin. They had flat, [[Nose/Legends|noseless]] faces adorned with frills that swept away from their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and mandible, collecting in whorls on the sides of their heads behind the jaw. The [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of a Gormak varied in color, with red, [[orange]] and blue varieties observed. The Gormak had clawed, three-fingered hands&mdash;also adorned with frills&mdash;and tended to possess a muscular build.<ref name="Gormak" /> The Gormak possessed a sexual dimorphism, with females being slightly shorter than males and lacking a whorl located above their nose.<ref name="TOR" /> The Gormak also had a natural mental acuity for understanding and employing technology.<ref name="Gormak" />

==Society and culture==
An aggressive species,<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gormak}}</ref> the Gormak held an innate love of warfare and competition,<ref name="TORweb-Creating Worlds">{{TORweb|url=news/blog/20100514_001|text=Creating Worlds|nolive=1}}</ref> and were extremely hostile toward the other natives of their planet, the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] species. The Gormak held a cultural belief that in order for them to prosper, the Voss&mdash;whom they viewed as an unnatural plague on the planet&mdash;must be destroyed.<ref name="Gormak" /> To achieve that goal, Gormak warriors repeatedly assaulted the Voss [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] over the course of centuries; however, despite their far greater numbers, they were never successful<ref name="Voss" /> as their warlike nature has kept them from uniting against their enemy. After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established embassies in [[Voss-Ka]], the Gormak viewed both factions as enemies, seeing the off-worlders as no different from the Voss.<ref name="Codex" /> Although their tribal society and [[Gormak (language)|basic speech patterns]] were considered primitive by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standards, their innate talent with technology rivaled the capabilities of the top minds of the Republic.<ref name="Gormak" /> From bits of scavenged electronics and discarded equipment, the Gormak constructed advanced tools, heavy machinery, [[Gormak rifle|specialized weapons]] and even cybernetic implants.<ref name="Codex" /> However, despite their incredible affinity for technology, the Gormak remained a pre-spaceflight culture confined to their homeworld, which caused them to be viewed as a backward species despite being perfectly capable of repairing, modifying and improving tech created by more advanced cultures.<ref name="Gormegan-1">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gormegan-1}}</ref>

[[File:Gormak.png|thumb|right|180px|A male Gormak warrior]]
The Gormak population was numbered in millions<ref name="Codex" /> and their society was tribal in structure, with Gormak spread throughout the wilderness of [[Voss]] in numerous nomadic clans numbering roughly a hundred individuals each.<ref name="Gorma-Koss">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gorma-Koss}}</ref> Within each tribe the position of responsibility to maximize the value of all salvaged equipment was held by a [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] with a particularly strong affinity for technology, to whom the other Gormak looked for guidance not just in matters of technology, but in their daily lives.<ref name="Gormak Shamans">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gormak Shamans}}</ref> By far the most populous sentient species on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]],<ref name="Gormak" /> the Gormak settled in camps, sometimes fortified by stolen off-world technology and actively avoided the forest known as the [[Nightmare Lands]] due to its mysterious corruptive influence.<ref name="TOR" /> The largest Gormak settlement on the planet was [[Gorma-Koss]] in the [[Gormak Lands]], where tens of thousands of Gormak have united their tribes at the base of an unnamed mountain under the leadership of [[Jokull]], the Gormak King.<ref name="Gorma-Koss" /> The Gormak constructed mines to strip the land of valuable resources for the construction of their machines and weapons, leaving desolation and monolithic structures behind.<ref name="TOR" /> Apart from working with existing technology, the Gormak also experimented heavily with organic-cybernetic hybrids, using Voss fauna as test subjects. Gormak hunting parties set out at regular intervals to trap [[mawvorr]]s, [[shaclaw]]s and even the deadly [[vorantikus]] alive so that the creatures could be implanted with cybernetic upgrades. These monstrous [[Ssorokk|cyberbeasts]] became faster, stronger and far more dangerous and could be programmed with specific instructions, making them into excellent guardians.<ref name="Cyberbeasts">{{TORcite|type=codex|Cyberbeasts}}</ref> The Gormak considered the meat of the insectoid shaclaw a delicacy, and became skilled at capturing and cooking them alive since the giant insects' flesh would become contaminated with toxins within minutes after death. The Gormak would only dine on the shaclaws during special coming of age feasts, and the capture and preparation of such meal was considered an essential part of the ritual celebration.<ref name="Shaclaw">{{TORcite|type=codex|Shaclaw}}</ref> The Gormak revered the local alpha predator vorantiki for their power and fearlessness, often depicting them in crudely scrawled pictures found inside Gormak domiciles.<ref name="Vorantikus">{{TORcite|type=codex|Vorantikus}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Nemok-Ta.png|thumb|left|160px|The spirit of Nemok-Ta, an ancient Gormak taught to use the Force]]
In ancient times, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] came to [[Voss]], where the Gormak were the only one native sentient [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Sith viewed Gormak as primitive and ignored them as they began to harvest the world's resources. However, the planet and the Gormak were irrevocably changed when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived and attempted to drive the Sith off Voss. Seeking allies among the natives, the Jedi agreed to teach some of the Gormak tribes on how to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], but the Gormak were unprepared for the knowledge. Those tribes underwent radical evolutionary changes in the course of a few generations, becoming a new species named the [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. The Jedi attempted to teach the Voss how to control their emotions and new powers, but the Voss instead attacked the Sith on the planet, bringing the new species in contact with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. This caused the dark side to become manifest in a Sith structure on the planet, and this entity came to take the name [[Sel-Makor]] as it gained intelligence.<ref name="Gormak and Voss Origins">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gormak and Voss Origins}}</ref> Sel-Makor began to feed on violence and suffering, fueling its dark side powers and spreading corruption across the surrounding area, which became known as the [[Nightmare Lands]], and the ancient Sith complex that the entity inhabited was known as the [[Dark Heart]].<ref name="The Dark Heart">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Dark Heart}}</ref> Not long after his creation, Sel-Makor captured the spirits of two of the Gormak who had been taught by the Jedi,<ref name="The Dark Hollow">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Dark Hollow|Voss}}</ref><ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|A Long Forgotten Evil|Voss}}</ref> [[Damek-Ol]]<ref name="The Dark Hollow" /> and [[Nemok-Ta]],<ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil" /> and imprisoned their spirits in slave bodies.<ref name="The Dark Hollow" /><ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil" /> Damek-Ol was imprisoned in the body of a [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]],<ref name="The Dark Hollow" /> while Nemok-Ta was placed in the body of an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]],<ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil" /> and the two became avatars of Sel-Makor's power.<ref name="The Dark Hollow" /><ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil" /> After the extermination of the Sith, the Voss forgot their origins and founded the city of [[Voss-Ka]] atop the planet's highest peak, while the Jedi eventually died out or departed.<ref name="Gormak and Voss Origins" /> Sel-Makor, meanwhile, influenced the Gormak's bloodlust and drove the far more numerous species to attack their cousins throughout the centuries so that he could feed off of their dark emotions.<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Visions of Light and Darkness|Voss}}</ref>

For [[Time/Legends|centuries]] between the sundering of the species and the re-discovery of Voss by non-native off-worlders, the Gormak settled across the planet and engaged in a seemingly endless war against the Voss species. Though restricted at the time to pre-flight technology, the technological aptitude, viciousness, and superior numbers of the Gormak made them a formidable opponent to the Voss. Despite that, the Gormak were held at bay by the training of the [[Voss commandos]], the [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] of the [[Voss Mystics]], and the fortifications of the Voss mountain-top city of [[Voss-Ka]].<ref name="Voss" /> Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that ended the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Voss was accidentally rediscovered by the larger [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3645 BBY]].<ref name="Voss-Date">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Paying Respects|Voss}} establishes that the [[Bas-Ton (imposter)|imposter Bas-Ton]] has been on [[Voss]] for five years, and he was sent there to infiltrate [[Voss (species)|Voss]] society after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] failed. Additionally, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' places the events of Act III, which include Voss, in approximately [[3640 BBY]]; thus, the invasion of Voss occurred in approximately [[3645 BBY]].</ref> An operative of the [[Star Cabal]] named [[Albathius]] arrived on Voss shortly after its discovery, and gained great influence among the Voss Mystics, becoming known as the "Shining Man" and convincing the Voss to stay neutral from the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between two governments. The Shining Man soon died, but his starship remained in the [[Chamber of Ashes]] of the Dark Heart, where it was guarded by a Gormak named [[Xanar]] for years afterwards.<ref name="The Prophecy of the Shining Man">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Prophecy of the Shining Man|Voss}}</ref>

[[File:Jokull.png|thumb|right|160px|Jokull, the Gormak King]]
At some point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a Gormak by the name of [[Jokull]] entered the [[Nightmare Lands]] and traveled to the [[Dark Heart]], entering the cave known as the Dark Hollow where Sel-Makor was most powerful. Instead of consuming the Gormak's mind like he had done to so many others, Sel-Makor instead chose to awaken within Jokull his species' natural ability&mdash;the power to see visions as the Voss did. Horrified that he had been corrupted and seeing all Voss as being marked with evil because of their powers, Jokull returned to the [[Gormak Lands]] and became king of his people in order to wage war upon the Voss&mdash;so that the Gormak would never be corrupted like he was.<ref name="Primary Target">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Primary Target|Voss}}</ref><ref name="The Gormak King">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Gormak King|Voss}}</ref> Under his leadership dozens of Gormak tribes united in [[Gorma-Koss]], where thousands of Gormak<ref name="Gormegan-1" /> set to work together on a massive project.<ref name="Gorma-Koss" /> Using pieces and equipment salvaged from the offworlders and the Voss,<ref name="Gormegan-1" /> the Gormak constructing a [[Gormak cannon]] to threaten Voss-Ka<ref name="The Gormak Cannon">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Gormak Cannon}}</ref> and a starship named ''[[Gormegan-1]]'' which they intended to use to travel to the stars.<ref name="Gormegan-1" /> These constructions were supported by the [[Tela Mining Operations]], while Jokull stored treasures and trophies from his conquests in the underground vault known as the [[King's Hall]]. In the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] the Gormak settled on the [[Fest Otur Island]] and began to cut down many of the trees in the region.<ref name="TOR" />

Trying to gain an alliance with the Voss, both the Republic and the Empire lent them aid in their fight against the Gormak. The Sith aided the Voss in destroying ''Gormegan-1''<ref name="Space Race">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Space Race|Voss}}</ref> while the Republic helped the Voss to destroy the Gormak cannon.<ref name="In the Crosshairs">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|In the Crosshairs|Voss}}</ref> In the process, Jokull was captured, and the Voss discovered Jokull's ability to see the future. They enlisted the aid of outsiders in retracing the Gormak king's steps in the Nightmare Lands, soon learning the truth of their species' creation.<ref name="The Dark Hollow" /><ref name="A Long Forgotten Evil" /> After Jokull and neutralized, a new leader named [[Raklann]] took charge of Gormak in the Pelath-Ri Marches, trying to destroy the [[Shrine of Healing]] from below and attempting to excavate and repair the ancient starship named ''[[Evuk-Nosk]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3636 BBY]]<ref name="date">{{TOR updates|4.0}}</ref> the galaxy was [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded]] by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], who after defeating both the Republic and the Sith Empire, placed dozens of massive [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]] called [[Star Fortress]]es in orbits of subjugated worlds to watch for possible uprisings.<ref name="KOTFE 4">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=4}}</ref> The [[Voss Star Fortress]] was protected by a [[Voss shield bunker|shield bunker]] located in the Pelath-Ri Marches, and the Gormak saw it as a source of the disease that affected their young, old and weak.<ref name="Resistance">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Voss: The Resistance|Voss}}</ref> In the face of a larger threat, the Voss and Gormak soldiers had united to defend their homeworld during the [[Invasion of Voss]], ending the centuries-long war between two species. Their alliance has proven surprisingly effective, with the meditative reserve of the Voss complimenting the ferocious strength of the Gormak to form a formidable army.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Voss-Gormak Alliance}}</ref>

==Gormak in the galaxy==
[[File:Rokuss.png|thumb|left|160px|Rokuss, a Gormak who traveled off-world to join the [[Eternal Alliance]]]]
In [[3640 BBY]]<ref>{{TOR dates|Voss}}</ref> a Gormak named [[Hadrik]], who was tired of the fighting between Voss and Gormak, learned the art of the [[dream-walking]]. While traversing the [[Spirit World]], Hadrik met with the Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] and in exchange for freeing his physical body from captivity and the passage offworld agreed to perform the [[Forbidden Ritual]] to heal Kallig's mind.<ref name="Necessary Sacrifice">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Necessary Sacrifice|Voss}}</ref> Hadrik traveled with Kallig into the Nightmare Lands, where they found the [[dream-rock]], containing the spirit of a Voss named [[Dal-Rin]]. Dal-Rin instructed Hadrik on how to use the rock on the ghosts inside Kallig's mind and defeat them. The pair proceeded to strip away the ghosts' disguises and bested them one-by-one, after which Kallig used the rock to heal themselves. Upon returning to the [[Voss Orbital Docking Station]], Kallig and Hadrik found [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Sor-Nak]] waiting for them, who declared that for taking a Gormak off Voss, his people would reject the Empire. To preserve Imperial interests, Kallig used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to make Sor-Nak forget about Hadrik, with Hadrik becoming the first known Gormak to leave his homeworld.<ref name="The Ritual">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Ritual|Voss}}</ref>

In [[3631 BBY]]<ref name="date" /> a Gormak warrior [[Rokuss]] teamed up with [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that opposed the Eternal Empire of Zakuul to take down the Star Fortress in orbit of Voss. Rokuss assembled a strike team of Gormak and joined the Commander in an assault on the [[Voss shield bunker|shield bunker]] protecting the Star Fortress, after which they traveled on the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="Destroy">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Voss: The Shield Bunker|Voss}}</ref> From there, the Commander infiltrated the Voss Star Fortress and destroyed it by overloading the [[Sun Generator]], after which Rokuss and his warriors remained to fight for the Alliance's cause in gratitude,<ref name="Recruitment">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Recruitment: Rokuss|Odessen}}</ref> though they later returned to Voss to fight in the defence of Voss-Ka during the assault by the [[Eternal Fleet]].<ref name="KOTET 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gormak are a new species created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an MMORPG [[Star Wars video games|video game]] by [[BioWare]], and were first mentioned in [[The Holonet]], a promotional media web feature. The Gormak are found only on Voss, where multiple quests and codex entries elaborate on their society and culture.<ref name="TOR" /> [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion later introduced the Gormak [[Rokuss]] as a companion character for players, available through the [[Star Fortress]] missions.<ref name="Recruitment" /> [[Fred Tatasciore]] did most of the voice work for them.
